verdicts.stale: a newer primary source says otherwise
verdicts.imprecise: right direction, wrong detail (overstated, wrong cohort, altered interval)
verdicts.wrong: the source does not say this or says the opposite; an identifier for another paper
verdicts.unsourced: no source on the record bears on the claim
verdicts.unreachable: the source could not be read; not counted as an error
